# Extract the year of the earliest such competition

    earliest_year = first_place_discus['Year'].min()
else:
    earliest_year = None

# Find the latest year in the entire dataframe (assuming the question refers to all competitions in the table)
latest_year = df['Year'].max()

# Calculate the duration in years
if earliest_year is not None:
    duration = latest_year - earliest_year
else:
    duration = 0
